chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Mufazzal, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to Dawud (peace be upon him): 'No servant from My servants would hold on to Me besides anyone from My creatures, recognizing that from his intention, then the skies and the earth and those in them would plot against him, except that I would make an exit for him from between them; and no servant from My servants would hold on to any one from My creatures, recognizing that from his intention, except that I would cut off the causes of the skies and the earth from his hands, and I would harden the earth from beneath him, and I would not care in which valley he perishes.'

key_terms.اعْتَصَمَ: to hold fast / to rely upon

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between holding on to God and holding on to creatures according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, found in al-Kafi, elucidates the metaphysical reality of tawakkul by contrasting exclusive reliance on Allah with dependence on created beings. It highlights that divine protection is contingent upon the sincerity of the heart's intention, promising an 'exit' from worldly constraints for those who cling to God, while severing the 'causes' (asbab) of support for those who rely on creatures. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the ontological link between spiritual intent and cosmic mechanics.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Mufazzal, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto Dawood<sup>as</sup>: “No servant from My<sup>azwj</sup> servants would hold on to Me<sup>azwj</sup> besides anyone from My<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, recognising that from his intention, then they plot against him, the skies and the earth and the ones in these, except that I<sup>azwj</sup> would Make an exit to be for him from between these; and no servant from My<sup>azwj</sup> servants would hold on to any one from My<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, recognising that from his intention, except that I<sup>azwj</sup> would Cut-off the causes of the skies and the earth from his hands, and I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Harden the earth from beneath him, and I<sup>azwj</sup> would not Care in which valley he perishes’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Mufaddal from abu ‘Abd Allah who has said the following:

“Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, sent revelation to David, ‘Any one among my servants who seeks protection with Me and not with any other creature, and I find this in his intention, thereafter even if all the heavens and earth and those in them conspire against him, I will most certainly find for him a way to escape. On the other hand, whoever among My servants tries to seek protection with My creatures, and I find this in his intention, I most certainly cut off from him all the means of the heavens and earth and make it (earth) extremely angry beneath him and I am not concerned in the least where he will perish.’”
